title: MixBusDecision
description: Set-and-forget mix-bus processing decision (light glue comp, broad EQ, limiter ceiling, target LUFS for mastering handoff). Distinct from MixDecision which is per-element.

compression_gr_db.description: Mix-bus glue comp GR. >3 dB is usually too much; redirect to mastering.

gain_db.description: Mix-bus EQ moves stay ≤±3 dB typical, never >±6.

limiter_ceiling_dbfs.description: Mix-bus safety limiter ONLY — final limiting belongs to Mastering.

target_peak_lufs.description: Handoff target for Mastering. Typical mix → master handoff: -18 to -16 LUFS integrated.

saturation.description: Whether the mix bus has any saturation/tape. Usually false; mastering owns saturation.
